intro.title: Intro to Code-Roast
intro.summary: Big ideas are better when we explore them together.
intro.brewDescription: Code-Roast is a place to ask why, share what we learn, and put ideas into practice. Our Brews distil topics in code, data, and business into visual lessons you can explore at your own pace.
intro.whatIsDesc: Code-Roast is for curious minds who like to ask why, share ideas, and learn by making.
intro.typesRules: Ideas that make complex things clearer.
intro.keyData: Data: Find meaning in the details.

roasts.title: Roasts: Where Curiosity Meets Craft
roasts.understandingDesc: The best ideas aren't always the loudest. We slow down, look closer, and make room for thoughtful work.
roasts.keyBrews: Small ideas with room to grow.

about.title: Our Story & Purpose
about.missionDesc: Code-Roast began with a simple belief: good things happen when people share what they're learning.
about.valuesCommunity: Community: Make space for each other.
about.invitationDesc: Whatever you're learning, there's a place for your curiosity here.

brews.title: Brews: What is a Brew?
brews.subTitle: A Brew is a compact learning experience designed to grow your skills, refresh your knowledge, and spark exploration of deeper concepts you can use every day.
brews.explanation: We don’t all have time for lengthy courses, so our Brews are crafted to spark your curiosity — covering the topics that matter most, from development and data science to business and project management.
